title: Raise conditional kappa to 0.00310261 with composed helper splits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The current published construction gives complete conditional **κ = 0.00310261**. It combines five fixed boundary relations from PR5602 with the PR5601 word and nine independent helper splits. The full bill has **66,618 paid calls, 12,976 productive fields and rank surplus 760**. The exact raw crossing is **(0.00310261511129, 0.00310261511130)**; the claim is tested at 0.0031026105. The selected frontier is unchanged.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/PROOF.md) · [Boundary relations](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/BOUNDARIES.json) · [Independent cuts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/SPLITS.json) · [Complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/RESULT.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/SOURCES.json).

The basis mechanism lets one independent helper finish at a common-frame cut and a new independent input use the suffix. Both complete boundary supports are checked. The five imported relations remove five paid H5 calls per local use; the nine splits add independent targets without a Gaussian call. The full caller charges all helpers, adapters, scalar operations, owned paths, queries, idles, routes, compiler tails and outer costs.

The five framework assumptions and helper-endpoint contract remain. No complete rounded multiplier, huge uniform word, independent human acceptance or global optimum is claimed.

## Task and overlap

The base is canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority 7. [Canonical coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19183208) records the changed `complex-new-helper-inventory` scope and public component releases. PR5602 was released before its fixed relations were composed. Only five relations apply; its sixth contact was removed by PR5565. No new boundary or frame search is introduced.

The last refresh found the released shared relay in PR5605/5608 and the preparation in PR5606. Their compatibility is now being checked on this exact source. The bound above belongs to this publication commit; no further composed gain is claimed until its complete check passes.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-subspace-splits
```

Normal and optimized registered replay pass at `3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36`. Checks cover every intermediate arbitrary-input interface, 565,504 transpose coefficients, 2,920 native maps, the physical caller, two exact moment engines, compiler conditions and all 58 outer predicates. Mutation controls reject false relations, support, basis work, credits and costs. Metadata, committed bytes and export integrity pass. A fresh read-only Git-free replay will verify the final compatible construction. Full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; all source-pin commits are verified branch ancestors.

The shared rank-one identity is not claimed as an exclusive discovery. This contribution is by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The same assistant constructed and checked it; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Independent scientific review remains pending. Further gains require a new exact combined word and complete invoice. The published components' headline gains must not be added. [Structured questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3db0f4bb618f8607874f888b410715ea606ddb36/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/TASK.json).
